Container.Name: gPhotos2Immich
Container.Overview:
gPhotos2Immich syncs Google Photos shared albums to Immich on a schedule, without any Google API key: it reads public shared-album links, downloads full-quality photos and videos with their taken dates and skips items already uploaded. The web UI shows live logs and has a Sync Now button; a sync can also be triggered with POST /api/sync (e.g. from Home Assistant).
First launch: create config.json (see Requires), open the WebUI, enter the Immich API URL (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:2283/api) and an Immich API key with the asset.read, asset.upload, album.create, album.read, album.update, albumAsset.create and user.read permissions (or All), then add your shared album links. Changes apply without a restart.
Only public shared links work: check that the album opens in a private browser window. The web UI has no password: never expose its port to the internet.
Container.Requires:
config.json is mounted as a single file and must exist before the first start, otherwise Docker creates a folder in its place. From the Unraid terminal:
mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/gphotos2immich echo '{}' > /mnt/user/appdata/gphotos2immich/config.json

Config.Name: Config file
Config.Description: Settings file written by the WebUI (create it first, see Requires)

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Sync state used to skip items already uploaded

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: Internal listen port (must match WebUI Port container port)

Config.Name: DISABLE_WEBUI
Config.Description: true turns the WebUI off (config.json must then be written by hand)
